## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit messages
- [ ] Schema changes are additive, or go into a new major directory
- [ ] ADR added or updated for an architectural change
- [ ] No hostnames, keys, session ids or personal paths in code, fixtures or docs
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Prompt or preset change: version bumped; Prompt CI (`prompt-ci` status) run by the owner. A deliberate
      quality-for-cost trade is declared as `prompt-ci: trade quality>=<lowest change> cost<=<highest change>%`
